captions.instagram:
Your Instagram may be doing its job — and still not produce appointments.

The leak can happen after the click. A patient moves between Instagram, your website, reviews and Google Maps. If the offer, proof or next step changes between surfaces, every extra tap adds friction.

The fix is one clear path across all four surfaces.

DM "4444" for a cross-surface check.
